gloss: getting on and off; boarding and alighting

definitions.gloss: getting on and off; boarding and alighting
definitions.explanation: The act of boarding and disembarking from a vehicle, train, or bus. Commonly seen on signs and in transportation announcements.

examples.japanese: {乗降|じょうこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ご⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful when getting on and off.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乗降客数|じょうこうきゃくすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧10{万人|まんにん}だ。
examples.english: The daily number of passengers getting on and off at this station is about 100,000.

examples.japanese: ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乗降|じょうこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please board and exit the bus from the front door.

notes:
Composed of {乗|じょう} (ride, board) and {降|こう} (descend, alight). A formal compound most often encountered in transportation contexts — station announcements, signs, and official documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乗降客|じょうこうきゃく}: passengers boarding and alighting
- {乗降客数|じょうこうきゃくすう}: number of passengers
- {乗降|じょうこう}⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧: boarding/exit door
- {乗降|じょうこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧: when getting on/off

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{乗車|じょうしゃ}→乗車：06201_jousha⟧: boarding (getting on only)
- ⟦{降車|こうしゃ}→降車：20612_kousha⟧: alighting (getting off only)
- ⟦{乗|の}り{降|お}り→乗り降り：21227_noriori⟧: getting on and off (native Japanese reading, more conversational)
